ui_bugs.component: Console hydration warning · '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'
ui_bugs.issue: Still emitted by React (1 occurrence on initial render). Root cause is NOT in NewFleetDVIR.jsx source — the file renders plain text inside <option>{u.unit_number} — {u.make_model}</option>. The injected <span data-ve-dynamic='true' style={display:contents} x-excluded='true'> wrapper around the dynamic text comes from the Emergent VisualEdit tooling auto-instrumenting array-mapped JSX expressions (x-source-var='truckSelectable'). It is dev-tooling-only and does not affect rendered output; safe to ignore in production builds. If undesirable in dev, the VisualEdit instrumentation needs to skip <option> children, or use a tag-aware injection mode.
